title: Multiscale Transcriptomic and Molecular Modeling Analyses Suggest DCPMU-Associated Epithelial Remodeling and Tumor Microenvironment Perturbation in Prostate Cancer.
snippet: DCPMU, a major demethylated metabolite of diuron, is an environmentally persistent contaminant with potential endocrine-disrupting and carcinogenic relevance, yet its mechanistic association with prostate cancer remains unclear.
